input.description: Top 10 parks by distinct arriving guests, 19-21 Sep 2026
input.sql:
SELECT p.PARK_NAME,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.GUEST_ID) AS DISTINCT_GUESTS
FROM   HAVEN_STORE.ARRIVAL.FCT_PARK_ARRIVAL a
JOIN   HAVEN_STORE.COMMON.DIM_PARK p
  ON   a.PARK_XID = p.PARK_XID
WHERE  a.ARRIVAL_DATE_XID IN (20260919, 20260920, 20260921)
GROUP  BY p.PARK_NAME
ORDER  BY DISTINCT_GUESTS DESC
LIMIT  10
